findings.problem: The hint rules out der Witz but not der Scherz, which is just as common for a joke in the sense of kidding (das war nur ein Scherz), so the learner could rightly answer with either word.
findings.fix: hint: kidding, the same word as fun (not Scherz or Witz)

back.target: fun; joke, jest (as in just kidding)
back.example: Don't worry, that was just a joke!

note: Austrians also commonly say Schmäh for kidding (das war nur ein Schmäh), but Spaß is just as normal there, so leaving regional as null is fine.
